channel.title: Escape to the Country
channel.desc: Jules Hudson gets to show off a gloriously sunny Cornwall to an entrepreneurial couple who are on the lookout for a property with potential for a holiday let business as well as a home. Jules also tours a disused china clay quarry, where work has begun to create a sustainable and inclusive garden village by building more than 1,000 energy-efficient homes.
